name: Securities Account Report V 01
definition: The SecuritiesAccountReport message sent by the executing party to an instructing party to provide the details of the securities account details as requested in the query.

MessageHeader.name: Message Header
MessageHeader.definition: Point to point reference elements, as assigned by the instructing party, to unambiguously identify the report message.

Pagination.name: Pagination
Pagination.definition: Provides details on the page number of the message.

ReportOrError.name: Report Or Error
ReportOrError.definition: Provides information on report or error resulting from the originating query message.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured elements and/or any other specific block.
